findings.comment: Transformer pads lack required clearance dimensions per UCM § 1.10.4 (10 feet from buildings on hot-stick side; 3-5 feet from fence on other sides; 6 feet minimum from parking/traffic area; 2 feet from sidewalk back-of-curb). No dedicated Austin Energy easement encumbering pad locations is documented on plans. No truck access requirements per UCM § 1.3.16 are shown (12-ft horizontal / 16-ft vertical clearance minimum; 20×35 ft set-up area). No Austin Energy coordination letters, design specifications, or clearance verification provided. Master Comment Report identifies UCM § 1.3.16 and § 1.10.4 as requirements but no compliance documentation is visible on submitted electrical design plan.

applicableAreas: Site boundary relative to light rail corridors
findings.comment: Site proximity to Project Connect light rail alignments or the East-West Downtown 4th Street Rail Corridor cannot be verified from submitted documents. No Capital Metro coordination letters, light rail corridor permit, or UROP (Utility Rules of Practice for Light Rail Transit Program) consultation documentation provided in site plan submittal.

applicableAreas: Utility easement areas including water line vault easement and transformer vault easement locations

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report - Land Development Engineering

findings.comment: Site plan depicts multiple utility easements (Exclusive Water Line Vault Easement around meter vault; Vault Easement around transformer pads) but License Agreement documentation required per UCM § 1.10.10.3 (for private AE easements) or § 14-11-41 (for public utility easements) is not visible or annotated on submitted plans. Master Comment Report (LDE1) indicates License Agreements must be documented for items within easements; compliance cannot be verified from available documents.

Demolition plan (Sheet 8) shows procedures for abandoning private water and wastewater lines and removal of existing utilities (fire hydrant, gas meters, water meters). However, plans do not explicitly identify or analyze whether any abandoned utilities create clearance conflicts with proposed building locations, utility infrastructure, or other site improvements requiring removal or relocation. Clearance conflict assessment not documented.

Demolition and utility tap plans reference removal and modification of existing public utilities in Valley View Road ROW (existing AC water main to be replaced with DI pipe; existing fire hydrant to be replaced; wastewater stub to be accessed). However, plans do not comprehensively document that all existing public or franchise utility facilities and service connections affected by proposed improvements have been identified and will be terminated at the ROW/property line boundary by respective utility companies prior to construction.

applicableAreas: Street yard landscape areas and parking lot islands with proposed trees
findings.comment: Sheet 21 (Electrical Design Plan) contains a note stating 'Tree Well need to look up appropriate detail,' indicating proposed tree wells, but the detail is not provided on submitted sheets. Landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not show tree wells; proposed trees are shown in parking lot islands/peninsulas or street yard planting zones. Electrical outlets for seasonal landscape lighting are not shown or annotated at tree locations on either the electrical plan or landscape plan.
